options.label: A
options.action: Attempt rescue from a safe location by reaching with an object, throwing a rope or floating object, or rowing to the drowning patient without entering hazardous conditions.

options.label: B
options.action: Do not enter hazardous water to attempt rescue; await or summon trained rescue personnel if available.

options.label: C
options.action: Perform in-water rescue according to level of training, expertise, equipment, and comfort level.

options.label: D
options.action: Avoid entering the water for rescue; attempt reach/throw/row strategies from a safe location if possible.

options.label: E
options.action: Insufficient explicit patient evidence to select a guideline recommendation.
